name: Captain Data
summary: LinkedIn people and company data: find, search via Sales Navigator queries, enrich profiles, work history, skills and company employees.

api_key.description: A Captain Data API key (app.captaindata.com/developers); each workspace user has their own. Sent in the X-API-Key header.

notes: Every call spends credits (see each endpoint); the daily credit quota is separate from the rate limit.
Rate limit by plan, from 1 request/second (Trial) to 40 (Titanium); a 429 means back off.
Paging is by cursor: follow the X-Pagination-Next response header (or pass its cursor) until it is absent. Page numbers were removed on 2026-01-15.
Search endpoints take a raw LinkedIn Sales Navigator query string, not keyword parameters.

endpoints.name: Get workspace quota
endpoints.summary: Credits left and billing information for the workspace.
notes: Free, but has its own low rate limit (5 to 100 requests per minute by plan).

endpoints.name: Find a person by name
endpoints.summary: A person's uid and LinkedIn URL from a full name, optionally with company name.

full_name.description: Full name, matched as an exact phrase.

company_name.description: Company name, for a more accurate match.

endpoints.name: Search people (Sales Navigator query)
endpoints.summary: People matching a LinkedIn Sales Navigator people search.

query.description: The query parameter value of a Sales Navigator people search URL (everything after ?query=).

cursor.description: Cursor from the X-Pagination-Next response header of the previous page; expires after 24 hours.

notes: 1 credit per request plus 1 per result; 25 results per page, and every page pays the request fee again.

endpoints.name: Enrich a LinkedIn profile
endpoints.summary: Full profile data from a LinkedIn profile URL.

li_profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL starting with https://www.linkedin.com/in/, /pub/, /sales/people/ or /sales/lead/.

full_enrich.description: Also include up to 5 experiences and 2 skills.

notes: 1 credit, 2 with full_enrich. No emails or phones.

endpoints.name: List a person's work experience
endpoints.summary: Complete work history of a LinkedIn profile.

li_profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (/in/, /pub/ or Sales Navigator); this or people_uid.

people_uid.description: Captain Data person uid from Find, Search or Enrich People; preferred over the URL.

notes: 1 credit per request plus 1 per 20 results.

endpoints.name: List a person's skills
endpoints.summary: Complete skill list of a LinkedIn profile.

li_profile_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (/in/, /pub/ or Sales Navigator); this or people_uid.

people_uid.description: Captain Data person uid from Find, Search or Enrich People; preferred over the URL.

notes: 1 credit per request plus 1 per 20 results.

endpoints.name: Find a company by domain or name
endpoints.summary: A company's uid and LinkedIn URL.

domain.description: Website domain without protocol or path; preferred.

company_name.description: Company name; send this or domain, not both.

endpoints.name: Search companies (Sales Navigator query)
endpoints.summary: Companies matching a LinkedIn Sales Navigator company search.

query.description: The query parameter value of a Sales Navigator company search URL.

cursor.description: Cursor from the X-Pagination-Next response header of the previous page; expires after 24 hours.

notes: 1 credit per request plus 1 per result.

endpoints.name: Enrich a LinkedIn company
endpoints.summary: Company profile data from a LinkedIn company URL.

li_company_url.description: LinkedIn company URL (/company/, /school/, /showcase/ or Sales Navigator /sales/company).

endpoints.name: List a company's employees
endpoints.summary: Employees of a company by its Captain Data uid, optionally filtered by a Sales Navigator people query.

company_uid.description: Company uid from Find Company or Search Companies.

query.description: A Sales Navigator people search query value, to filter.

cursor.description: Cursor from the X-Pagination-Next response header of the previous page; expires after 24 hours.

notes: 1 credit per request plus 1 per result; 25 per page, so a full page is about 26 credits.
